items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Customer Success Agent you will serve as a primary subject matter expert for Coinbase’s products, providing world-class service and support to our most valued customers. You’ll join a team of customer focused support professionals who know their performance is essential to Coinbase achieving its mission. We’re looking for an individual who has a passion for making the customer experience seamless and phenomenal. What you’ll be doing (ie. job duties): Responsible for providing support for high-profile Coinbase customers across multiple channels (phone, messaging & email) by investigating, troubleshooting and resolving customer issues. Use all available resources to ensure high standards are met and work is carried out in the most efficient manner. Be a trusted advisor, listen and empathize so the customer knows they are valued. Ensure their voices are heard through accurate issue tracking and upstream solutions. Take ownership and use critical thinking to find the root cause and solve the customer issue on the first contact. Where this is not possible, ensure all defects are logged appropriately. Seek opportunities to add value for customers through education, proactivity and clear expectation setting. You will be responsible for providing best in class customer support, handling customers proactively to mitigate issues, handling contacts through to resolution, and collaborating across teams of subject matter specialists to fix issues with urgency. Model an investigative mentality: utilize data and customer feedback to help address critical customer issues at the root cause and eliminate defects in the customer experience. Proactively identify customer needs before they become an issue to simplify the customer experience, reduce friction, and strengthen trust in Coinbase. Champion clear communication with internal and external partners to align on solutions and drive results. Develop a deep understanding of Coinbase products and ongoing changes in the macro crypto environment so you can guide customers to navigate the quickly moving and ever changing crypto world and unlock additional features, services, and products that benefit their unique profile. What we look for in you (ie. job requirements): This role requires full-time, in-office presence, five days a week. Willingness to work nights and weekends to support the 24/7 nature of cryptocurrency markets. Motivated by Coinbase’s mission and creating a seamless experience for our highest value customers. Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in a customer service or support role in a fast paced environment including working with high value customers. Basic knowledge of blockchain, web3, staking, ROI/staking rewards, self-custody, and/or crypto. Flexible and adaptable to meet the evolving needs of a high-growth and fast paced organization. Fantastic communication and relationship management skills, passion for assisting customers to use Coinbase products successfully, and an eagerness to create a community of high value Coinbase power users. Nice to haves: Experience at crypto exchanges or in financial services, ideally in payments, trading operations or technical support. High level of proficiency in cryptocurrency and Coinbase products Experience in training and/or quality auditor roles Experience in Banking, Wealth Management, Corporate Finance, Asset Management or FinTech Understanding of Google apps, JIRA, Salesforce Service Cloud, or Amazon Connect. items.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Platform Intelligence
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Platform Intelligence turns each new Claude model's abilities into API features that developers can build on. Our goal is to make the full intelligence of each model available through the API. We own the capabilities that shape what Claude can do for developers: tool use, built-in tools such as web search and code execution, thinking controls, structured outputs, and the memory, files, and skills APIs. We also run the API side of every Claude model launch, including its safety features and controls. That means getting the API ready for each new model, coordinating with research, safeguards, product, and cloud partners, and making sure the model, its features, the SDKs, and the docs all ship together on launch day. The work sits where research meets product. We work with new models before they are public. When a model gains a new ability, we work out what it should look like as an API, build it, and ship it to developers on our own platform and on cloud platforms. Those decisions shape how developers first use each model. We also own API versioning and the evals that tell us a capability works in production. What you'll do You'll lead the design, build, and operation of API capabilities used by developers around the world. You'll work with research to understand what a new model can do and turn that into an interface that is simple, durable, and hard to misuse. You'll lead the API side of new model launches. You'll plan the work, track readiness across teams, resolve the issues that come up late, and see the launch through on the day. Between launches, you'll make the next one faster and safer. You'll set technical direction for work that spans several teams, write clear design proposals, review API designs from other teams, and mentor engineers on the team. Representative projects Lead API readiness for a Claude model launch, so that every feature works on day one across our API, SDKs, docs, and cloud partners Take a new model ability from research prototype to public API feature, from interface design to production rollout Build and operate tools such as web search and code execution under real traffic Automate the manual parts of a model launch Build the evals that catch a capability regression before a launch You might be a good fit if you: Have led technical projects that spanned several teams, from design through launch and operation Have designed and operated production distributed systems where correctness, latency, and availability all matter Have strong product sense and care about API design and developer experience Make sound technical decisions with incomplete information, as models and priorities change close to a launch Explain tradeoffs clearly to research, product, and go-to-market partners, including non-engineers Make the engineers around you better through design review and mentoring Use AI tools as a regular part of how you design, build, and review software Care about the societal impacts of your work and Anthropic's mission to build safe, beneficial AI Strong candidates may also have: Building public APIs, SDKs, or developer platforms Working with large language models, including tool use, agents, or evals Running launches or migrations with fixed deadlines and many dependent teams Building tools for agents, such as search or code execution Storage, memory, or context systems at scale Integrating with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Location Preference: Preference will be given to candidates based in NY, SEA, SF or the Bay Area given the current location of team. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $405,000 — $485,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. Coinbase Creative Studio operates at the intersection of art, culture, and technology. We create original, high-impact work that helps define the Coinbase brand and bring our products to life in differentiated ways. Our portfolio spans large-scale brand and product campaigns with month-long timelines, as well as high-priority assets that need to move from brief to delivery the same day. We partner closely with internal creatives, producers, strategists, marketers, and some of the world’s leading agencies and production partners to deliver work across channels and formats. As Design Operations Manager, you will own and evolve the operating model that enables our design and motion teams to do their best work. You will sit at the center of our creative ecosystem, connecting people, processes, partners, and priorities across a diverse portfolio of work. You will own resource planning for full-time and contract design and motion talent, set resource and capacity strategy across the portfolio, and help scale the studio through a global ecosystem of agency and production partners. You will own the process for how work is planned, resourced, prioritized, reviewed, delivered, and reported, and lead selected creative initiatives across multiple workstreams. You will bring structure and clarity to a fast-moving environment while protecting the quality, timeliness, and ambition of the work. This role is ideal for an experienced design operations leader who has delivered creative work for world-class brands and products across a range of media, and who knows how to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution. What You’ll Do Define and own the design and motion operating model for Creative Studio, including how work is planned, resourced, prioritized, reviewed, delivered, and reported. Set resource and capacity strategy across a broad portfolio of creative work, balancing business priorities, timelines, skill sets, and team health. Build and scale a global ecosystem of contract talent, agencies, and production partners, including sourcing, onboarding, engagement, and management of external partner performance. Establish operating rhythms, planning systems, and reporting that give senior stakeholders clear visibility into capacity, priorities, risks, and delivery. Lead high-impact design and motion initiatives across multiple workstreams, ensuring the work meets a high bar for quality, scope, timeliness, and brand expression. Partner with creatives, producers, strategists, marketers, and senior cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex business priorities into executable creative plans. Identify bottlenecks and create scalable tools, processes, and solutions that increase the team’s speed, effectiveness, and ability to deliver exceptional work. Exceptional organizational judgment, with the ability to set priorities, anticipate tradeoffs, and create clarity across complex and shifting workstreams. items.title: Senior Associate, Compliance Model Governance
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Senior Associate, Compliance Model Governance on the Compliance team, you'll own quantitative testing, monitoring, and data quality for the AI and statistical models that power Coinbase's financial crime compliance programs, including transaction monitoring models. You'll sit between Compliance, Data Science, and Engineering, designing the tests, building the pipelines and dashboards that track model health, and ensuring every model in production is defensible to Internal Audit and regulators. What you'll do: Design and execute quantitative testing for AI and ML models before and after launch, including input data quality testing, variance and stability testing, and performance testing for agentic and LLM-based systems, producing documentation that holds up to independent model validation and regulatory examination. Build and maintain monitoring pipelines and dashboards that track model inputs, outputs, and downstream outcomes (e.g., SAR performance metrics), applying statistical tests to detect drift and degradation and delivering clear health readouts to model owners and Compliance leadership. Own data lineage for compliance-critical data elements, designing data quality checks that feed Compliance's data quality control framework and partnering with Engineering to trace data from source systems to control consumption. Write production-quality SQL and Python pipelines, diagnosing and fixing pipeline bugs and leading data migrations that support external regulatory reporting. Build detective monitoring scenarios that test whether compliance controls are working, writing and validating the underlying SQL logic. Prepare testing evidence, model documentation, and walkthroughs for Internal Audit, model validators, and regulators, responding to findings and tracking remediation to closure. Required Skills and Experience: 4+ years of experience in data science, model risk, quantitative analytics, or data engineering, ideally in financial services, fintech, or another regulated setting. items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Strategic Finance Data Science team helps OpenAI understand business performance and make informed decisions about growth, revenue, and resource allocation. We partner with Strategic Finance, Data Engineering, and business teams to build trusted metrics, explain what is changing, and support forecasting, planning, pricing, and investment decisions. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement to turn complex financial and business questions into reliable data products, clear analyses, and actionable recommendations. You will work across the analytical workflow: define the question, establish trustworthy metrics and datasets, investigate the drivers, and help partners act on the findings. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will combine the technical depth of analytics engineering with strong analytical judgment and close partnership with Strategic Finance. Your work will serve both executive reviews and the teams making day-to-day business decisions. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Define and maintain trusted metrics and analytical datasets for revenue, usage, customer performance, compute consumption, and margin, with clear definitions and appropriate product, customer, and cohort detail. - Build automated dashboards and recurring reporting that help Finance leaders and operating teams understand performance, spot changes, and prioritize investigation. - Explain movements in business results and variances against expectations by examining underlying drivers, validating data quality, and distinguishing evidence from assumptions. - Translate ambiguous questions about growth, retention, monetization, pricing, and resource efficiency into structured analyses and practical recommendations. - Partner with forecasting specialists and Finance to provide reliable inputs, driver analyses, and scenario assumptions for forecasts and long-range plans. - Work with Data Engineering to improve the quality and usability of underlying data, and develop reusable analytical models and workflows that reduce manual effort. - Communicate findings clearly, align stakeholders on trade-offs, and follow through to understand whether the analysis or data product improved the decision. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU - Have strong SQL and analytical data-modeling skills, and experience turning large, complex datasets into reliable analyses and reusable data products. - Can reason carefully about metrics, cohorts, denominators, measurement changes, and uncertainty, and investigate whether an unexpected result reflects the business or the data. - Have built dashboards or recurring reporting used by business partners, and can explain the decisions they enabled. - Bring sound business judgment and can independently scope an ambiguous problem, prioritize the work, and deliver an end-to-end solution. - Communicate technical findings clearly and work effectively with Finance, data scientists, engineers, and other business partners. - Can use Python or a comparable analytical tool to investigate data and automate repetitive work. items.title: Staff Software Engineer, Government Products
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the Team & Role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Robinhood has been tapped as the brokerage and initial trustee for Trump Accounts, and is working alongside BNY and The U.S. Department of Treasury to develop and operate the program, which aims to expand market access for the next generation of Americans. In this role, you will help build a world-class, intuitive platform, leveraging Robinhood’s industry-leading financial technology to deliver a standalone web and app experience for this historic national initiative. The Government Products team focuses on building and scaling systems that support long-term investing and account management for millions of customers. This team works closely with product, data, and infrastructure partners to deliver reliable, secure, and intuitive experiences. You will help shape systems that enable customers to plan for their financial future with confidence! As a Staff Backend Engineer , you will serve as a foundational technical leader for this 0-to-1 initiative. You will be responsible for designing and building the critical backend architecture, pipelines, and complex cross-functional integrations required to interface securely with government systems. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where you will directly shape a platform built to serve millions of future customers This role is based in our New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What You'll Do Lead the technical design, architectural strategy, and implementation of a brand-new, standalone backend infrastructure optimized for security, reliability, and scale. Design secure data pipelines and robust APIs to integrate government-backed registries, employer contribution frameworks, and institutional banking systems. Guide engineering teams across Robinhood's broader brokerage ecosystem, fostering technical excellence, setting high bar code standards, and mentoring senior engineers. Partner closely with Product, Security, Legal, and external stakeholders to navigate the unique protections and technical compliance protocols of a highly regulated government contract. Own backend stability and performance tuning ahead of initial high-volume user rollouts and the general public launch. What You Bring 8+ years of software engineering experience with a proven track record of operating as a principal or staff-level engineer, driving multi-year technical vision, long-term architecture, and strategic direction for large-scale distributed systems. Advanced mastery-level proficiency in designing, building, and maintaining high-throughput, low-latency distributed infrastructure and secure data pipelines using Python or Go. Deep expertise in domain modeling, microservices architecture, and building highly reliable APIs capable of orchestrating complex cross-functional data flows across multiple engineering domains. Demonstrable execution in a zero-to-one product space, navigating high levels of technical ambiguity, setting foundational engineering patterns, and systematically de-risking complex technical blockers. Experience serving as a primary technical point of contact across an entire organization, with a strong commitment to raising the engineering bar by sponsoring and mentoring senior engineers. Exceptional communication skills with a proven capability to partner closely with Product, Security, Compliance, and external institutional partners to translate highly complex legal or regulatory constraints into clean, maintainable backend infrastructure. Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. items.title: Member of Technical Staff (GTM Engineer, Growth)
items.description: In 2026, we launched Computer, the defining product for the new era of agentic AI. Millions of people and teams adopt Perplexity and Computer on their own, and the Growth team owns the loops that turn that adoption into lasting usage and revenue. We're hiring a Growth GTM Engineer to build the systems that turn product usage into revenue and turn self-serve usage into enterprise pipeline. You'll turn first-party Computer and Enterprise usage into account-level signals. You'll ship the in-product paths that capture sales intent, and build and validate those signals with data science. Alongside product engineers, you ship production code, instrument the product and run experiments. You'll partner closely with Revenue Operations, who own Salesforce, CPQ, routing and sales reporting. Tech Stack: TypeScript | Next.js | React | Python | PostgreSQL | Snowflake | Eppo | AWS WHY PERPLEXITY IS DIFFERENT - Craftsmanship. We build high quality, tasteful products targeting both the AI native and AI curious. - Ownership. You identify the problem, design the solution and ship it. - Entrepreneurship. We think like founders, act with urgency, and hustle to deliver for each other and our users. - Scholarship. Work among highly talented peers, pursuing knowledge and truth, upleveling ourselves, our teams, and our products. - Partnership. We amplify each others' strengths, break down silos, and give selflessly to help our colleagues deliver excellence. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build account-level PLG signals: map users and workspaces to accounts, and define the activation, expansion and intent signals that predict an enterprise deal. Publish them as trusted models that sales use for scoring and routing. - Own the in-product paths from self-serve to sales, like contact-sales entry points, high-intent upsells and meeting booking, across web and app. Decide who sees them, when and with what context, and measure them end to end, from surface to booked meeting to pipeline. - Lead experiments end to end on sales-assist surfaces and targeting, from hypothesis and instrumentation through analysis and rollout. Partner with Data Science to measure meetings and qualified opportunities, not just clicks. - Build the internal tools and automation Growth and GTM teams run on - Partner closely with Sales, Sales Systems, Data Science, Marketing and Product to turn product signals into pipeline. Be upstream partner to sales systems that own Salesforce, CPQ and routing QUALIFICATIONS - 2+ years as a growth, GTM, data or full-stack engineer, shipping production code (TypeScript/React, Python). - Strong SQL and comfort building data models in a warehouse (Snowflake, dbt-style). - Experience instrumenting product events and running A/B experiments end to end. - Commercial instinct: you start from a revenue problem ("trial-to-enterprise conversion won't move") and work back to the signal or surface that fixes it. - Comfort with REST APIs, webhooks and integrating third-party GTM tools. - Operator mindset: you talk to customers directly, ship fixes, and don't need a PM to translate requests. NICE TO HAVE - Experience in a PLG-to-enterprise motion: product-qualified leads, scoring users into accounts, sales-assist flows. - Experience as a GTM or growth engineer at a B2B SaaS or GTM-tooling company. - Entity resolution, dedup or domain enrichment. - Familiarity with Salesforce, Default, Chili Piper, Intercom, Clay, Hightouch/Polytomic or similar (as a consumer and integrator, not an admin). - Experience building LLM-powered internal tools or agents.

items.title: Partner Specializations Lead
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role The Claude Partner Network is how consulting firms, systems integrators, and other services partners build practices around Claude. When a company chooses a partner, it wants to know which firms have done this work well, in its industry and for its use case. Specializations are how the program will give it: credentials showing that a partner has demonstrated expertise in a given domain area. As Partner Specializations Lead, you'll own this program end to end: the requirements a firm has to meet, the evidence review that decides who qualifies, the benefits that make a specialization worth earning, and the operating rhythm that keeps it credible year after year. Your job is to take an early framework into a structure that scales: opening it to thousands of partners, running evaluation cycles, and launching new specializations with cross-functional input. This role suits someone who likes owning a standard. You'll work with partner managers, operations, enablement, marketing, and industry teams who each hold a piece of the program, and with senior leaders at partner firms who care a great deal about the outcome. A specialization only means something if it's earned, so you'll need to be rigorous with evidence, consistent in your decisions, and firm and clear when the answer is no. Key responsibilities Own each specialization's requirements, evidence standards, and benefits, and keep them current as our products and the partner network change Run each evaluation cycle from invitation to decision: collect partner evidence, reconcile it against internal data, lead the review, and document every decision Make and defend qualification decisions, including borderline cases, and apply the standard consistently across firms of very different sizes Communicate outcomes to partner executives and their Anthropic account teams, including clear guidance for firms that did not qualify Open the program to the wider partner network, and recommend which specializations come next based on customer demand, partner readiness, and Anthropic's priorities Define the evidence standard for new specializations with Applied AI, Product, and industry go-to-market teams Coordinate the teams that deliver the program's benefits (marketing, the partner directory, field enablement, technical support) so that earning a specialization leads to something real Work with Partner Enablement so that partner learning paths and certifications support each specialization Build the operating rhythm: renewal, remediation periods, an appeals path, and the tracking and reporting that show whether the program is working Design the review process to scale, using Claude and automation so that routine steps don't depend on a person Write and maintain partner-facing guidance (program guide sections, FAQs, application materials), clear enough for a partner to know where it stands without asking us, and internal guidance for field teams Use program data to recommend where each requirement's bar should sit and when it should move, and bring those recommendations to partner leadership Minimum qualifications Experience owning an external-facing program with published requirements (a partner, channel, certification, accreditation, or similar program), including running at least one full evaluation, qualification, or renewal cycle Experience making qualification or eligibility decisions against a written standard and communicating those decisions, including declines, to senior external stakeholders Experience working with CRM or PRM data, such as Salesforce reports or a partner portal, as a regular part of your job Strong writing: able to produce clear program requirements, decision memos, and partner-facing guidance that need little editing Experience leading work to a fixed date across several teams you do not manage, such as operations, marketing, enablement, and field teams Work effectively where the process is still being built and the details are still changing Are excited about Anthropic's mission to develop AI that is safe and beneficial Preferred qualifications Experience designing or running a partner competency, specialization, or credential program at a technology company Experience with services partners (systems integrators, consultancies) from either side: managing them at a vendor, or building a practice around a vendor's technology at a firm, and an understanding of how those firms decide where to invest their people SQL or BI-tool skills sufficient to pull and check your own program data Experience taking a program from its first launch to a repeatable operating cycle Experience launching a program publicly with marketing and communications partners Enough technical depth to judge whether a partner's evidence of a software or AI deployment holds up Experience working with customers in regulated or specialized industries, such as financial services, healthcare, or the public sector Experience designing partner benefits or incentives, and an understanding of how they change partner behavior Hands-on experience building AI workflows with Claude or similar tools, and curiosity about how AI changes professional services delivery The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $300,000 — $365,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Head of ASEAN, Applied AI
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About Anthropic Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As the founding leader of Applied AI Solutions Architecture in Singapore, you will drive the adoption of frontier AI by enabling the deployment of Anthropic's products (Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, and API) across ASEAN enterprises and digital-first organizations. You'll leverage your technical skills and consultative sales experience to drive positive AI transformation that addresses our customers' business needs, meets their technical requirements, and provides a high degree of reliability and safety. You'll be responsible for building and leading the ASEAN Applied AI team from the ground up. Applied AI comprises Solutions Architects, Product Engineers, and Finetuning Engineers. You will establish processes and best practices for the region's technical pre-sales engagements based on your years of experience, help each team member achieve success, high productivity, and career growth, and represent Anthropic as a technical lead on some of its most important partnerships across ASEAN. In collaboration with the Sales, Product, and Engineering teams globally and locally, you'll help enterprise partners across ASEAN incorporate leading-edge AI systems into their cutting-edge products and platforms. You will employ your excellent communication skills to explain and demonstrate complex solutions persuasively to technical and non-technical audiences alike. You will play a critical role in identifying opportunities to innovate and differentiate our AI systems, while maintaining our best-in-class safety standards. Responsibilities Build and manage the foundational team of Applied AI professionals in ASEAN regions (Solutions Architects and Product Engineers) providing both technical guidance and career development Set goals and reviews for your team, promoting growth and output Work with a handful of highest-value enterprise customers across ASEAN on their overall AI adoption strategies, focusing on pre-sales technical excellence including use case scoping, technical champion building, and POC execution Partner closely with your aligned GTM leadership to understand customer requirements & co-build GTM strategies to drive adoption for ASEAN enterprise customers Contribute to thought leadership through conference presentations, webinars, and technical content creation within the ASEAN market Own the technical portions of pre-sales engagements, ensuring your team provides compelling demos and validates enterprise customer ROI from Anthropic products Drive collaboration from cross-functional teams to influence and unify stakeholders at all levels of the organization to drive business outcomes Travel regularly to customer sites across ASEAN for executive-level sessions, technical workshops, and building relationships Establish a shared vision for creating solutions that enable beneficial and safe AI in technology products Lead the vision, strategy, and execution of innovative solutions that leverage our latest models' capabilities Stay current with emerging AI/ML trends and competitive landscape in the ASEAN enterprise tech sector, including the region's highly regulated industries (financial services, government, resources) You may be a good fit if you have 15+ years of experience as a Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or similar pre-sales technical role 5+ years of technical go-to-market management experience, specifically managing pre-sales teams Experience working with ASEAN enterprise customers and understanding local business culture, procurement processes, and decision-making dynamics across ASEAN Familiarity with the ASEAN regulatory landscape (e.g., Singapore Privacy Principles, APRA CPS 234, data sovereignty requirements) and how it impacts enterprise AI deployments Experience with the unique technical requirements and technical procurement process of enterprise tech companies Deep technical proficiency with enterprise AI deployments, API integrations, and production LLM use cases Have an organizational mindset and enjoy building foundational teams in a relatively unstructured environment Have excellent communication, collaboration, and coaching abilities Are comfortable dealing with highly uncertain, ambiguous, and fast-moving environments typical of the tech industry Strong executive presence and ability to foster deep relationships with technical leaders and engineering teams Have at least a high level familiarity with the architecture and operation of large language models and/or ML in general Experience with prompt engineering, LLM evaluation, and architecting AI-powered systems Make ambiguous problems clear and identify core principles that can translate across scenarios Have a passion for making powerful technology safe and societally beneficial Think creatively about the risks and benefits of new technologies, and think beyond past checklists and playbooks Stay up-to-date and informed by taking an active interest in emerging research and industry trends Understanding of developer tooling, SDKs, and technical integration patterns common in enterprise tech companies Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.description: About the Team Financial Engineering (FinEng) builds the financial systems behind ChatGPT, Codex, and OpenAI’s API platform. These products serve people, developers, and businesses around the world. We make them easy to buy, use, and pay for. Our systems support everything from individual subscriptions to usage-based billing and complex enterprise agreements. We also build the foundations for how products are packaged, accessed, and used: product catalogs, SKUs and bundles, workspaces, entitlements, and usage metering. These systems connect what customers purchase to the capabilities they can access and the usage they can manage. That reach creates challenging engineering problems. We build services and data pipelines that handle large volumes of usage and transactions, keep payments, product access, and financial records consistent across systems, and adapt as products and pricing change. The same foundations must support a simple checkout and the detailed spending controls a large business needs. Your work will help teams launch new products faster and give customers confidence in what they are paying for. The work spans customer experiences, backend services, and data systems, with opportunities to influence technical design and see your work through to production. We’re hiring Staff+ engineers with strong backend experience. Experience in payments, billing, or financial systems is a strong plus, but not required. In this role, you will: - Design and build systems for purchasing, payments, subscriptions, and billing across OpenAI products and global markets. - Build product catalogs, SKUs, and bundles that let product teams launch new offerings and evolve how products are packaged. - Develop workspace and entitlement systems that connect purchases and subscriptions to product access for individuals and teams. - Keep charges and product access correct when requests are retried, updates arrive late, or another service fails. - Build metering systems, data pipelines, and APIs that turn large volumes of usage into accurate bills, timely spending information, and records that are easy to trace and verify. - Create reusable building blocks that let product teams launch new offerings, pricing, and payment options without rebuilding the foundations each time. - Make complex financial workflows simple for customers and internal teams, using customer feedback and experiments to improve the experience. - Scale and evolve live systems while protecting customer access, financial accuracy, performance, and security. - Own problems from early design through launch and operation, working with product, design, finance, and other engineering teams to make and test important technical decisions. Nice to Have - Experience with payments, subscriptions, pricing, billing, or other systems that manage customer purchases and revenue. - Experience with product catalogs, packaging and bundles, workspace management, entitlements, or usage metering. - Experience building financial or transaction systems at scale, checking that records match across systems, or supporting compliance and audits. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. Also offering Poker, Horse Racing, and Casino games across various countries and continents, it is an inspiring and forward-thinking company: every day brings new challenges in a modern and dynamic environment. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: 💡An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate 📈Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day 🏡A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us. 🌟A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,600 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in Bordeaux Are you passionate about sports and tech? Your mission will be to build and develop Betclic’s Voice of Customer (VoC) approach to better understand the issues affecting customer experience and trust, and help teams turn these insights into concrete improvements. Use AI, analytics and customer tools to connect these sources, while ensuring data quality and reliable findings. Identify and prioritise customer irritants based on their frequency, severity, affected customers, and impact on experience and trust. Where the evidence allows, distinguish broader market trends from issues specific to Betclic. Analyse situations that may undermine trust and consistency across customer touchpoints. Engage relevant teams to investigate issues, make recommendations and drive corrective actions. Build VoC governance and help foster a customer-centric culture by sharing findings, aligning stakeholders at all levels around common priorities, and establishing continuous improvement routines. Success measures: Key sources of customer feedback are consolidated and used regularly. Priority irritants lead to tracked actions with the relevant teams. VoC findings inform decisions across Customer Ops, Product, Marketing and other relevant teams. VoC actions are tracked with relevant indicators, and their impact is assessed with the teams responsible for implementing them. You have the ability to structure varied feedback, develop clear recommendations and drive implementation across teams without direct authority; experience engaging senior stakeholders (Director, VP or C-level) is a plus. You have a strong interest in AI and analytics tools, with the judgement to assess their outputs and limitations. You have data awareness; experience with Tableau, Power BI, Omni or equivalent tools is a plus. You have excellent synthesis, communication and coordination skills, and professional French & English. items.title: Head of Partner Services Delivery and Success
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About Anthropic Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As the leader of Partner Services Delivery and Success within Partnerships at Anthropic, you will lead the global field delivery, partner success and partner health teams that make Claude deployments succeed at our customers when our partners build and run them. This is a senior leadership role on the Partnerships leadership team, reporting to the Global Head of Partnerships. A deployment starts with work the business wants an agent to do: a research process in a bank, claims handling at an insurer, engineering workflows in a retailer. A partner's engineers build it against the customer's own systems and data, evaluate it on real work rather than a demo, and put it live. If it holds, the customer builds the next ten themselves and the partner carries the pattern to the next customer in that industry. What good means is the same every time, whoever builds it: on time, on track, high quality, high customer satisfaction, and impact the customer can see in their own business. Holding that across thousands of deployments a year, almost none of which your own people build, is the job. This is a build, and it is a scaling problem. The function is new, the teams are mostly still to be hired, demand is growing far faster than any team can be hired against it, and the way we deploy agents is changing faster than a method written down in advance can keep up with. What you will own Deployment strategy and approached. Bringing the best ways to deploy Claude to our customers through partners: which deployment approaches we back, which partners we build them with, and how both change as the models and the use cases move. Field delivery. A global organisation across the Americas and international markets, which you hire, lead and grow. Our own people, in region, alongside the partner's team on live engagements: they run the delivery cadence, hold the work to date and quality, and are the first to know when something is going wrong. Most of the team sits here, and it is accountable for deployments landing on time and on track, to a high quality bar, with high customer satisfaction and impact the customer can see in their own business, against the customer's own deployment plan rather than a partner work order. Delivery assurance. The standard a Claude deployment is held to, how it is inspected on live engagements, and how a shortfall gets back to the partner as root cause rather than as a complaint. Where a partner's own delivery practice meets that standard, you approve them to carry the work and you assure the result. Partner success. The partner's own capability to deliver. One person is the point of contact across everything a partner is building, and the method is built with partners rather than handed to them: the patterns that worked on real engagements, turned into something the next partner can run, and the centres of excellence inside our largest partners that let their own engineers deliver to our standard. Partner health and escalation. An honest read on how every partner is really performing, held apart from the teams that own the commercial relationship so the score can be trusted. A falling score starts an escalation, and it is how we decide what a partner is ready to take on next. Working with the account team. Account executives, the partner account and success teams, and the partner's own delivery leadership, so that a deployment has one plan and one set of owners rather than three. The relationships. Delivery leadership at our largest partners, technology and business leadership at their clients, and Applied AI, Customer Success, Sales, Product and Engineering inside Anthropic. Delivery capability in markets that do not yet have any, built with partners who have not done this work before. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com. 📐 ABOUT THE ROLE This is where security meets innovation at enterprise scale. As a security engineer, applications at WRITER, you'll be building the security foundations that protect the AI systems powering some of the world's most recognizable brands. You'll work at the intersection of application security, AI infrastructure, and developer enablement—partnering with engineering teams to embed security into every line of code while ensuring our platform remains both powerful and trustworthy. The opportunity is massive: you'll help define how enterprise AI applications are secured, from threat modeling our LLM architectures to building automated security controls that scale across our growing platform. This isn't about saying "no"—it's about finding creative ways to say "yes, and here's how we do it securely." items.description: 🚀 About WRITER WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com. 📐 About the role Design engineers sit at the intersection of design and engineering. As a design engineer at WRITER, you'll own the Writer Design System (WDS) — how it's built, how it's maintained, and how both humans and AI agents use it to ship product. This role matters more now than ever. AI coding agents write more of our production code, and they ship whatever they find. A design system that's incomplete or inconsistent doesn't just slow designers down; it gets compounded at scale by every agent that builds against it. You'll make sure WRITER's core UI library is complete and trustworthy enough to build on, working closely with the designers, PMs, and engineers who rely on it every day. You'll help shape the surfaces that define how our product feels to use, and help set the standard and process for how the EPD org ships product. This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco, Chicago, Austin, New York City, Seattle, or London hubs. This role will be reporting to the Director of product design. We are open to hiring for this role at multiple levels, with compensation ranges scaled to match your experience, expertise, and the scope of the role. 🦸🏻‍♀️ What you'll do - Own the Writer Design System (WDS) as your primary domain — agentify and maintain it, ensuring it's optimized for both humans and AI agents building with it - Design and build production-quality UI components and features, owning surfaces from sketch to ship - Ship design-led work that wouldn't survive an engineering backlog — polish passes, micro-interactions, and brand moments that make the product feel alive - Architect new primitives and extend the system's core components, shaping its technical direction while keeping documentation, examples, and libraries in sync across Figma, .md skills, and Storybook - Uphold the bar for front-end craft across accessibility, motion feel, consistency, and quality, ensuring accessibility is baked into every design system component - Help shape the design-to-code workflow, researching the latest tools and practices to unlock org-wide productivity and democratize workflows across the EPD organization - Partner with designers, PMs, and engineering leads to measure WDS adoption, close gaps, and make sure shipped features meet design system standards ⭐️ What you need - 4–8+ years building production frontends with TypeScript and React, with a track record of owning a system, platform, or surface end-to-end rather than individual features - Solid instincts for animation principles including easing curves, choreography, anticipation, follow-through, interruptibility, and perceived performance - Fluency in Figma at expert level — auto-layout, variants, variables, and code connect — and proficiency with design engineering technologies like framer-motion, gsap, and lottie for web-based animation - A demonstrable obsession with craft, backed by a portfolio, side projects, GitHub, or production work that includes systems-level work and not just feature work - Experience driving adoption of a design system or shared platform across an engineering org, with a track record of influencing technical or design direction beyond your immediate team - Experience with AI product surfaces — tool-call UIs, streaming responses, agent state, and dynamic UI rendering — and comfort navigating ambiguous, cross-team problems with good judgment about when to loop others in - A genuine commitment to WRITER's values of Connect, Challenge, and Own 🍩 Benefits & perks (UK full-time employees): - Generous PTO, plus company holidays - Comprehensive medical and dental insurance - Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks) - Fertility and family planning support - Early-detection cancer testing through Galleri https://www.galleri.com/partner/writer - Competitive pension scheme and company contribution - Annual work-life stipends for: - Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc. - Learning and development stipend - Company-wide off-sites and team off-sites - Competitive compensation and company stock options

items.title: Counsel, AI Safety & Cyber Incident Response
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Legal team helps address the cutting-edge legal questions that arise from developing and deploying advanced AI. The Security and Public Sector Legal team helps protect OpenAI’s technology, systems, data, and people and supports the safe and responsible use of our tools. We work closely with technical and operational teams to provide practical advice on novel, consequential, and fast-moving issues. About the Role We are seeking a counsel to help lead legal responses to cybersecurity and AI safety incidents. This is an opportunity to bring deep incident response expertise to some of the hardest questions in AI, and help build the legal frameworks and practices for answering them. You will advise on complex cybersecurity incidents, from discovery through to resolution, and also help develop our response to incidents involving the safety of our models and tools. AI safety incident response is a new and rapidly evolving legal practice area. Your work will help define how frontier AI companies investigate and respond to safety events such as unexpected model behavior, degradation of safeguards, harmful uses of our services, and potential harm to third parties—often where established legal standards do not yet exist. Working directly with Security, Safety, Product, Engineering, and colleagues across Legal, you will advise on consequential decisions where established approaches may offer little guidance. We are looking for a practical, dynamic lawyer who can turn incomplete information into clear recommendations, exercise sound judgment on novel questions, and follow matters through to resolution. You will help establish the facts, assess risks, and guide investigations, communications, remediation, and reporting. You will also turn lessons from individual incidents into durable response processes, helping further develop a legal function that evolves alongside the technology. This role is based in Washington, D.C. or San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will be: - Serving as legal lead on assigned cybersecurity and AI safety incidents, coordinating fact development, legal analysis and advising, cross-functional escalation, and follow-through with the response team. - Working with investigators to understand incident scope, attack paths, root cause, and affected systems and data, and potential third-party impacts, while helping teams distinguish established facts from gaps in the evidence. - Managing outside counsel and third party service provider engagements necessary to incident response. - Serving as key Legal point of contact for cross-functional teams. - Partnering with Privacy, Product, Regulatory, and other counsel to assess notification and reporting obligations, advise on timely customer and user communications, and coordinate third-party outreach and incident-related information sharing with industry peers and government partners. - Preparing concise incident updates and decision materials that distinguish established facts, uncertainties, options, and recommended next steps. - Developing severity-based escalation criteria, response playbooks, exercises, and clear decision and handoff processes for cybersecurity and AI safety incidents, adapting established practices to emerging model risks. - Supporting post-incident reviews, tracking agreed corrective actions, and turning lessons into practical improvements to safeguards and response processes. You might thrive in this role if you have: - A JD and a license or qualification to practice law in your jurisdiction. - 5+ years of relevant experience. - Relevant legal experience managing cybersecurity or privacy incident responses or comparable complex technology investigations at a technology company, law firm, or government agency, including work with technical teams, other counsel, and communications partners. - The ability to translate technical findings into practical legal advice, with a working understanding of technical information. - Sound judgment under time pressure, clear communication of uncertainty, and an understanding of when to act, seek specialist advice, or escalate. - Clear, concise writing and the ability to keep cross-functional teams aligned through changing facts and competing priorities. - Ownership of details and follow-through, paired with collaborative work with colleagues who bring different expertise. - A strong interest in the novel challenges of AI safety and a willingness to help develop new approaches. Direct AI incident experience is helpful; strong transferable incident response skills are welcome. - Availability to participate in time-sensitive incident response, including occasional work outside normal business hours. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. You'll work at the intersection of energy markets, utility operations, and AI infrastructure needs, leading multi-hundred megawatt procurement efforts and building strategic relationships with utilities, grid operators, and regulators across multiple jurisdictions. This role is essential to ensuring Anthropic can scale compute capacity efficiently while navigating complex energy market dynamics and regulatory environments to achieve the speed and scale required for frontier AI development. Responsibilities: Lead energy procurement and markets strategy to secure multi-hundred megawatt power capacity for AI infrastructure, structuring utility partnerships and commercial agreements that prioritize speed-to-energization and scale Own utility and regulatory stakeholder management across multiple jurisdictions, building strategic relationships with ISOs, transmission operators, and utilities to accelerate interconnection timelines and unlock constrained capacity Drive energy markets and policy strategy for AI compute facilities, monitoring regulatory developments and engaging policymakers to address grid capacity challenges and expedite approval processes for critical infrastructure Partner with engineering and delivery teams to translate energy market dynamics and utility constraints into actionable capacity acceleration strategies that align procurement schedules with aggressive project timelines Develop deep market intelligence on regional power availability, markets for large-scale infrastructure projects Have deep expertise in wholesale power markets, utility interconnection processes, and transmission system planning Have experience securing 100+ MW of The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible. About the Role Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy. You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI. This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you'll: - Manage a portfolio of accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan - Lead our prospects’ journeys from consideration to successful deployment - Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects - Own a consumption revenue target - Manage consumption revenue forecasts - Analyze key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders - Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies - Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering - Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates - Support the development of company culture We're seeking someone with experience including: - 9+ years selling platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service - Designing and executing complex deal strategies - Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies - Working directly with c-level executives - Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders - Leading high-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.) - Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence You might thrive in this role if you: - Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor. - Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future. - Are a builder.
