items.title: Staff Enterprise Architect
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . The Enterprise Architecture team turns business objectives into technology decisions across Coinbase's business systems including custom-developed, third-party applications, and agentic automations, partnering with business functions and engineering teams to buy, build, and scale software applications with a focus on design patterns, technical debt, and security. This Staff Enterprise Architect will own key Enterprise Engineering (EE) initiatives such as Technical Debt, Application Portfolio Management, Integration Keys Mechanism, and contribute to the Architecture Forum. What you’ll do: Provide leadership and expertise in the development, maintenance, and governance of enterprise architecture guidelines and design patterns to ensure the reliability and scalability of the application ecosystem. Develop and maintain technical roadmaps to guide the evolution of the application ecosystem from current to future states, aligning with strategic and business capability roadmaps. Drive application portfolio health programs focused on identifying, mitigating, and eliminating technical debt and security hardening where appropriate. Evaluate new applications and platforms to ensure alignment with the organization’s technology and governance strategies, policies, and standards from business, application, data, solution, and technology perspectives. Develop and maintain system diagrams that illustrate the relationship between business value, capabilities, and technology. Contribute to an Architecture Forum of architects and engineers, facilitating collaboration, debate, and education on acceptable design patterns and solutions. Lead the analysis and evaluation of leading and emerging technologies and market trends, assessing their impact and opportunities for the enterprise architecture, with a focus on digital capabilities and innovations to support business strategy. Work closely with solution architects to provide frameworks, guidelines, and best practices for implementing and configuring applications and database technologies. Contribute to large-scale, enterprise-wide transformation initiatives, overseeing technical aspects from current state assessments through delivery and execution. Required Skills and Experience: Experience in Enterprise Architecture: At least five (5) years of hands-on experience in Enterprise Architecture, with a proven track record of collaboration with domain, data, and security engineers, as well as solution architects. Expertise in Architecture Standards: Demonstrated ability to develop, document, and publish Enterprise Architecture guidelines and design patterns that align with organizational objectives. Cybersecurity: Proficient in security best practices including authentication, authorization, encryption, integration key management, and logging. Technical Debt Management: Significant experience in leading efforts to identify, monitor, and strategically reduce technical debt across the enterprise. OKRs Delivery with Architectural Impact: Strong background in setting and achieving Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) that have broad and lasting impacts on architectural decisions and outcomes. Team Collaboration and Leadership: History of working within high-performing teams, offering constructive feedback, and fostering an environment of continuous improvement. Escalation Management and Decision-Making: Skilled in handling complex escalations, effectively communicating trade-offs, and driving decisions to timely and successful resolutions. Effective Stakeholder Communication: Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex architectural concepts to a diverse range of stakeholders, including senior technical and business leaders, subject matter experts, peers, and technical delivery teams. Nice to haves: Passion for Emerging Technologies: Strong enthusiasm for the crypto, blockchain, and NFT industries, with an understanding of their impact on the economy. Enterprise Platform Experience: Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce.com, NetSuite, Anaplan, Workday, Contentful, or comparable systems, with the ability to leverage these tools effectively. Performance Optimization for High-Load Systems: Experience in designing or enhancing the performance of high-load customer service platforms, ensuring scalability and reliability. Quantitative Risk Modeling in Architecture: Experience in developing quantitative architecture risk models, including the measurement of technical debt and trade-offs using risk factors. Understanding of SDLC Methodologies: Knowledge of various Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodologies, including both Agile and non-Agile approaches. Systems-Level Programming Proficiency: Proficiency in at least one systems-level programming language, with Go being highly preferred. Frontend and Backend Development Skills: Familiarity with modern development frameworks and languages, including Go, React, JavaScript, TypeScript, and their related ecosystems. Data Management Expertise: Experience with SQL and modern data stores, such as Snowflake, for managing and querying large datasets. Salesforce Architecture Knowledge: Deep understanding of Salesforce (SFDC) architecture, including multi-org strategies and customization best practices. Proficiency with Development and Collaboration Tools: Strong proficiency in using Git, Confluence, Jira, LeanIX, or equivalent tools for version control, documentation, project management, and enterprise architecture. items.title: Data Annotation Specialist, Safety
items.description: Who are we? Our mission is to scale intelligence to serve humanity. We’re training and deploying frontier models for developers and enterprises who are building AI systems to power magical experiences like content generation, semantic search, RAG, and agents. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. We like to work hard and move fast to do what’s best for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are passionate about their craft. Each person is one of the best in the world at what they do. We believe that a diverse range of perspectives is a requirement for building great products. Join us on our mission and shape the future! Why this role? We are on a mission to build machines that understand the world and make them safely accessible to all. Data quality is foundational to this process. Machines (or Large Language Models to be exact) learn in similar ways to humans: by way of feedback. By labeling, ranking, auditing, prompting, red teaming, and correcting output, you will improve Large Language Model’s performance for iterations to come, thus having a lasting impact on Cohere’s tech. Cohere is looking for Data Annotation Specialists with backgrounds and skills in Trust & Safety, Content Moderation, AI model evaluation, or related fields. This role is best suited for candidates who bring strong contextual judgment, cultural and bias sensitivity, and experience applying nuanced guidelines to complex or ambiguous content. Successful candidates will be highly detail-oriented, comfortable evaluating safety risks across different user intents and scenarios, and able to make consistent, well-reasoned decisions with a high degree of independence after onboarding. IMPORTANT CONTEXT ON THIS ROLE: In this position, you will be asked to engage with human-generated and model-generated tasks which will sometimes mean intentional exposure to explicit content. Your annotations on these explicit tasks will be used to prevent the Large Language Model from generating unintentional, adversarial, toxic, or unsafe outputs. The types of explicit content you may be exposed to may include but are not limited to those of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature. Please Note: This is a part-time, remote, independent contractor position available within Canada or the United States. We seek candidates who are able to commit to 16 hours per week minimum at a 45 CAD/hour or 40 USD/hour contract rate, depending on your location, consisting of 30/hour base pay plus 15 CAD or 10 USD/hour hazard pay. This role is BYOD 💻 - Bring Your Own Device (laptop). 12 months contract with potential for extension. As a Data Annotation Specialist on safety task, you will: - Evaluate and improve model safety: Label, rank, audit, and refine human- and model-generated text to improve safety, quality, and policy alignment, including content that may be sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing. - Apply nuanced safety judgment: Assess model outputs against detailed safety guidelines, rubrics, and style standards, making consistent decisions across ambiguous, sensitive, and context-dependent cases. - Create prompts and safety test cases: Write realistic prompts, user scenarios, and adversarial examples that help evaluate model behavior across safety categories and uncover unsafe, evasive, over-refusing, or policy-inconsistent responses. - Support quality and calibration: Identify annotation inconsistencies or unclear guidelines, and provide actionable feedback on recurring edge cases, model failures, and opportunities to improve data quality. - Work with precision and independence: Complete annotation tasks with strong attention to detail, while being comfortable working independently in a globally distributed, asynchronous team environment. You may be a good fit if you have: - 1+ years of experience in Content Moderation,Trust and Safety, AI data annotation, LLM evaluation, or a related analytical role, with exposure to quality assurance, red teaming, and/or prompt engineering preferred. - Experience applying detailed guidelines to complex and sensitive content, with strong contextual and sociocultural judgment and the ability to recognize and manage personal bias. - Emotional resilience: Comfort working with content that contains unsafe, explicit, and/or toxic content, including content of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature. - Excellent command of written English and the ability to clearly justify content evaluations, including why an output is safe, unsafe, high-quality or low-quality. Bonus points if you are fluent in another language! - Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, with the ability to maintain consistency across high-volume and monotonous tasks. - Strong execution in a remote environment, including good time management, comfort using new tools, and the ability to work independently in a global, asynchronous team. The Candidate Journey: Initial Screening - Once you have submitted your application our Talent Team will review your resume and writing samples. Virtual Annotation Test - This assignment will test your written skill through various language-based tasks, such as a a writing sample, interacting with a chat bot, and more. Video Screen - If selected to move forward, you will have a short video call with a member of our Operations Team! Offer - Independent Contractor Agreement As an independent contractor, you maintain control over how you complete your work and may work with multiple clients simultaneously, although we ask you to declare if any of these are with a direct competitor of Cohere and maintain IP confidentiality of the Cohere project. Independent contractors are not eligible for health benefits or other benefits provided to employees. Compensation for services is provided to contractors by contractors invoicing for services provided pursuant to the terms of our agreement with the contractor. It is important to understand that as an independent contractor, continuous work is not guaranteed. The client-contractor relationship is fundamentally project-based, meaning engagements may be temporary, periodic, or intermittent based on our organizational needs and project availability. As an independent contractor, you should anticipate fluctuations in workflow and therefore compensation for services when Cohere does not require as many hours of services in a week. Prospective candidates, please be advised: this role involves working with human generated and model generated tasks that may involve exposure to not safe for work (NSFW) text content as part of data annotation tasks, including explicit, offensive, or other inappropriate material. If some of the above doesn’t line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply! We value and celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive work environment for all. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.

items.title: ML Silicon Performance Lead
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM: OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. Building on efforts like Jalapeño, the team is developing future generations of AI-native silicon and tightly integrated systems to power the next generation of frontier models. By co-designing chips, systems, tools, and methodologies, the team helps deliver faster, more efficient, and production-ready hardware for OpenAI’s supercomputing platform. ABOUT THE ROLE: We’re looking for an ML Silicon Performance Lead to drive hardware/software co-design for our silicon architecture. You will work across models, kernels, compilers, and silicon to shape how ML workloads map to hardware—and how the hardware should evolve to support them. Your work will connect model and workload requirements with compute, memory, and specialized acceleration capabilities to maximize performance, efficiency, and scalability across current and future generations of AI silicon. You’ll partner closely with ML research, compiler, and silicon architecture teams to jointly develop software approaches and hardware capabilities. From kernel mapping and quantization to new data structures and specialized IP, you’ll evaluate hardware and software tradeoffs to improve performance, efficiency, and utilization across large-scale AI workloads. Through performance modeling, simulation, and hands-on optimization, you’ll guide architectural decisions and validate improvements on representative workloads. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Drive hardware/software co-design across ML research, compiler, and silicon teams, jointly shaping kernel implementations and hardware capabilities to meet workload performance and efficiency goals. - Partner with ML research to translate model and workload needs into kernel performance targets and compute, memory capacity, and bandwidth requirements, feeding hardware constraints and opportunities back into model and algorithm choices. - Map and optimize ML kernels for architecture, using insights from data movement, memory hierarchy, and execution efficiency to guide both software improvements and hardware design. - Co-design support for new data structures and quantization formats across kernels, compilers, and silicon, balancing model quality, numerical behavior, performance, power, and implementation cost. - Define and help develop specialized acceleration IP, working with compiler and silicon partners to determine the right division of functionality across software, instructions, and dedicated hardware. - Drive ML performance modeling and simulation with the compiler team to compare hardware/software design options, expose bottlenecks, and quantify end-to-end benefits on representative workloads. - Partner with the Silicon Architecture lead and silicon team to specify and validate new IP, using kernel and simulation results to refine requirements and prioritize architectural improvements. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have deep experience with ML accelerator architecture and how compute resources, memory systems, and data movement shape workload performance. - Can translate model-level behavior into concrete kernel requirements and hardware design decisions. - Have built or used accelerator performance models and simulators, and know how to validate their assumptions and interpret their limitations. - Have hands-on experience optimizing ML kernels, including identifying bottlenecks and improving utilization, locality, and execution efficiency. - Understand quantization and numerical formats, including their implications for model quality, memory bandwidth, compute efficiency, and hardware support. - Have experience with hardware/software co-design and can reason about whether a capability belongs in a kernel, compiler, instruction set, or dedicated hardware. - Work effectively across research, compiler, and silicon teams, bringing clarity to ambiguous requirements and building alignment through technical evidence. items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About Beneficial Deployments Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most. About the Role We're looking for an Applied AI Architect to join Beneficial Deployments, focused on helping public health, global health and humanitarian organizations get real value from Claude. You'll be the technical lead for partners such as public health agencies and ministries of health, the institutes and NGOs that support them, and humanitarian organizations working in crisis settings. You'll help them find where Claude makes a real difference, from disease surveillance and outbreak response to health data, communications and program delivery, design solutions that fit their data, privacy and procurement rules, and turn early pilots into lasting deployments. What works for one partner becomes something the whole field can use. Responsibilities Serve as the primary technical advisor to a portfolio of health partners from discovery through deployment, turning their priorities into scoped use cases with clear measures of success. Design and demo solutions with Claude, the API, Claude Science and Claude Code across surveillance, outbreak response, data analysis and public communications. Guide partners through security review, data governance and procurement, from national agencies to field operations. Run workshops, trainings and tabletop exercises that build AI fluency across partner teams. Build reusable assets (reference designs, connectors, prompt and eval templates) so one partner's work helps the next. Spot patterns across partners, bring field insight back to Product and Research, and help partners measure what changed. Travel to partner sites for workshops, technical deep dives and relationship building. You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have 3+ years in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, sales engineering, forward-deployed engineering or technical consulting. Experience working with public health agencies, ministries of health, global health or humanitarian organizations, or similarly complex public institutions, including how they buy, adopt, and govern technology. A track record of making technology stick inside slow-moving organizations with many stakeholders. Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs: you can prototype a working demo. You don't need to write production code. Clear written and spoken communication across a broad audience. The ability to explain technical tradeoffs to epidemiologists, program leads, field teams and executives. items.description: About the Team The Strategic Finance team provides financial insights and guidance to support the organization's long-term goals and strategies. We partner across the business to allocate and deploy our resources for the highest impact outcomes. About the Role Our Workloads team under Research focuses on maximizing the performance and efficiency of model inference, enabling OpenAI to develop and deploy frontier AI models at scale. We are hiring a senior Strategic Finance business partner to work closely with our Workloads team to drive improvements in model serving efficiency and compute economics. You will partner directly with researchers and engineers to identify and prioritize high-impact optimization opportunities, establish frameworks to measure performance, and translate technical improvements into financial outcomes. This is a great role for folks who have an interest in how AI research intersects with compute. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Partner with Inference researchers, Scaling, Product, and Data Science teams to identify, evaluate, and prioritize optimization opportunities, weighing customer and economic trade-offs across model performance, latency, throughput, engagement, and compute cost. - Drive cross-functional strategic initiatives to improve inference efficiency by establishing clear ownership, coordinating work across teams, and tracking execution progress. - Establish key performance metrics, dashboards, and analytical frameworks to identify inference performance gaps and quantify the financial impact of improvements. - Partner with Compute Finance and other Strategic Finance teams to incorporate expected inference efficiency improvements into long-term compute demand forecasts, capacity planning, investment decisions and financial projections. You might thrive in this role if you have: - A technical academic background (e.g., computer science, engineering, or mathematics) or current experience partnering closely with research or engineering teams on technical problems. - 8–10+ years of experience in management consulting, strategy & operations, strategic finance, or a related analytical role. - Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with a track record of turning ambiguous problems into actionable recommendations and measurable impact. - Executive presence and communication skills to build credibility with researchers and engineers, align stakeholders, and explain technical and financial trade-offs. - An entrepreneurial mindset, with experience building processes and independently driving initiatives from idea through execution. - Technical curiosity and enthusiasm for frontier AI and inference economics. - Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, cloud computing, or technical performance optimization is a plus, but not required. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. In 2026, our team built an entirely new category of financial product in partnership with the U.S. Treasury — investment accounts for every child born in America. The app debuted at #3 in the App Store and #1 in Finance. Now we’re designing what comes next: new platforms and new experiences that will shape how future generations of Americans start building wealth. Getting every child invested early is how we continue to democratize finance for all. This role is for a content designer at the top of their craft who wants to make an impact on a national scale. Success looks like a generation of Americans entering adulthood already invested and confident in how money grows. items.title: Growth Program Manager
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
items.description: About the role Our Growth team finds, engages, and onboards the engineers, finance professionals, scientists, and other domain specialists whose judgment teaches AI systems how to reason in their field. We're looking for a Growth Program Manager to own the programs that make that happen. This role is strategy and execution. You'll decide what to build and why, then build it. You'll take new initiatives from early and messy to scaled and repeatable, then move on to the next highest-impact problem. The programs you'll own are still being built, and you'll run them at a volume that surfaces problems nobody has seen yet. You'll use AI and automation to keep them from breaking as they scale. We're looking for real ownership. You treat the program as your own, hold yourself accountable for the results, and don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. What you'll do Set the strategy for your programs: define goals, identify the biggest levers, and decide where to invest Own execution end to end and be accountable for outcomes like pipeline, conversion, time-to-productive, and retention Build and lead the teams that run your programs, including hiring leads who own their areas and setting clear expectations and performance standards Build sustainable expert pipelines through targeted outreach, new channels, and creative approaches Build AI workflows and automations that replace manual work in sourcing, outreach, screening, onboarding, and reporting, such as LLM-drafted outreach, lead enrichment, triage agents, QA checks, and self-updating dashboards Stand up reporting that shows how each program is performing, where the gaps are, and what to do about them Run a steady cadence of experiments on targeting, messaging, channels, process, and tooling, then turn what works into playbooks that people and agents can run Partner closely with growth leads, operations, project teams, and vendors to align on priorities and keep work unblocked Once a program is in steady state, hand it off cleanly and take on the next one Who we're looking for 4+ years of experience in program operations, growth, recruiting or workforce operations, strategy and operations, or a similar role You've owned a program end to end, from setting the strategy to executing it. You were the person accountable when something broke, and the person who fixed it. You move comfortably between big-picture thinking and details, and you're as happy building a plan as you are working through a spreadsheet Experience building and managing teams, ideally distributed or contractor-based Strong judgment about prioritization when there's more work than time, and you know when to escalate and when to resolve on your own Data-driven: comfortable defining metrics, digging into funnels, and making decisions from imperfect data. You can run your own analysis in SQL or Python. High agency and ownership. Ambiguity doesn't slow you down, and you thrive when given room to build something from nothing. items.title: Engineering Manager, API Multicloud
items.description: About the Team API Multicloud partners with cloud service providers (CSPs) to bring OpenAI’s frontier models and APIs into the cloud environments where developers and enterprises already build. We own the API end to end across CSP platforms, from API integration and request routing through inference execution, capacity management, and day-to-day operations. Our mission is to make these capabilities available broadly and safely while preserving the reliability and developer experience customers expect from OpenAI. Delivering that experience requires work across the stack: adapting API services and cloud-native integrations, bringing up model-serving environments, validating new releases, and operating the systems that connect customer requests to available capacity. We work directly with CSP engineering teams and partner closely with OpenAI’s inference, API, infrastructure, security, and Safety Systems teams. Together, we turn new model capabilities and partner requirements into dependable production services, with attention to performance, operational readiness, and efficient use of compute. Our work contributes to OpenAI’s AWS partnership https://openai.com/index/openai-on-aws/, including the launch of Daybreak Red and Daybreak Blue on Amazon Bedrock https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2026/08/openai-daybreak-red-and-blue-on-amazon-bedrock/ — and OpenAI’s newly announced Google Cloud partnership https://openai.com/index/openai-models-google-cloud/ will bring our frontier models and Codex agentic workflows to Google Cloud’s Model Garden. These efforts let customers use OpenAI capabilities within the cloud infrastructure, security controls, and workflows they already rely on. About the Role We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead the team responsible for building and operating OpenAI’s API across major cloud service providers. You’ll lead a team of engineers focused on establishing scalable, reliable, and efficient cloud deployment platforms that bring OpenAI’s frontier models to customers across multiple cloud environments. In this role, you'll own the technical direction, execution, and operational excellence of the API Multicloud platform. You'll guide your team through complex infrastructure challenges, including deploying model-serving environments, scaling capacity, optimizing performance and utilization, and building reusable systems that enable OpenAI to expand across CSP platforms. You'll balance long-term architectural investments with the urgency of delivering new model capabilities and partner integrations. You'll work closely with engineering leaders across inference, API, infrastructure, security, and Safety Systems, while building strong technical partnerships with CSP engineering teams. Your team will play a critical role in determining how quickly OpenAI can bring new models to market, how reliably those models operate, and how efficiently we scale our infrastructure across cloud providers. You'll also be responsible for building and developing a high-performing engineering team, setting clear technical priorities, and fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and operational excellence. In this role, you will: - Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering team responsible for building and operating OpenAI's API infrastructure across multiple cloud providers. - Define the technical vision, strategy, and roadmap for API Multicloud, ensuring the platform is scalable, reliable, and efficient. - Drive the architecture and execution of complex distributed systems that support API routing, model serving, and cloud infrastructure across CSP environments. - Partner closely with inference, API, infrastructure, security, and CSP engineering teams to launch new models, expand platform capabilities, and deliver reliable production services. - Own the reliability, performance, and operational excellence of the platform, driving improvements in capacity planning, infrastructure efficiency, and deployment processes. - Recruit and develop exceptional engineering talent, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement. - Set clear priorities, navigate ambiguity, and drive cross-functional execution while balancing near-term business needs with long-term technical investments. You might thrive in this role if you have: - Experience leading, building, and developing high-performing engineering teams responsible for large-scale cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, or platform engineering. - Strong technical background in distributed systems and cloud infrastructure, with the ability to drive architectural decisions and provide technical guidance to senior engineers. - Experience building and operating production infrastructure on major cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure. - Proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional engineering initiatives from architecture through production launch and ongoing operations. - Strong understanding of scalability, reliability, performance optimization, and infrastructure efficiency in large-scale production environments. - Demonstrated ability to hire, mentor, and develop engineering talent while fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and execution. - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing technical direction across engineering teams and external partners. - Experience with AI infrastructure, inference systems, or model serving is a plus. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link https://form.asana.com/?k=bQ7w9h3iexRlicUdWRiwvg&d=57018692298241. items.title: Field CTO, MENA
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE The Field CTO role is one of Mistral's senior external technical voices; a role for someone who has earned genuine credibility in the AI field and can engage enterprise boards, CIOs, and CTOs as a peer. You will shape how strategic accounts think about their AI strategy, represent Mistral at major industry events, and publish thought leadership that reflects a real point of view on where AI is going. You will work closely with regional sales leadership across your territory and bring what you learn from executive conversations back into Mistral's product direction. This is an externally-facing, influence-driven role. The output is measured in relationships built, content published, and executive conversations that move. WHAT YOU WILL DO Executive engagement Run Mistral's Executive Briefing Center with your regional VP; a selective program for C-level stakeholders at strategic accounts. Build and sustain trusted-advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and VP Engineering across your territory. Thought leadership Publish regularly: articles, whitepapers, and analysis of where enterprise AI is heading. Brief Gartner and Forrester on Mistral's roadmap and market position. Track frontier research and bring it into customer conversations. Conference and event presence Represent Mistral at major industry events through keynotes, panels, and roundtables. Build a public presence that generates inbound interest from enterprise executives and the wider AI community. Market feedback Bring what you hear in executive conversations back into product direction. Patterns across accounts on governance requirements and deployment constraints should reach the people building the models. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Demonstrable credibility in the AI field. A public track record in AI: published papers, articles, or talks that reflect a clear, defensible position. Your work should read as credible next to Mistral's technical brand. - A stated position on open-weight models and what they change for the enterprises adopting them. Your existing public positions should sit comfortable next to Mistral's. - You are fluent in European data sovereignty and on-premise deployment, at the level that holds up with a CTO or VP Engineering asking hard questions. - You are comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders across multiple verticals on technical architecture and business strategy, in the same conversation. - Cross-vertical fluency, you can credibly engage across financial services, manufacturing, defense, and energy without being a domain specialist in any one of them. - 10–25 years of experience in enterprise technology. You have held roles such as: Field CTO, Principal Architect, or VP Engineering at a major cloud or AI company, or a founder who built technical credibility and executive relationships through their own company. - Comfortable with 30-50% travel depending on your region. NICE TO HAVE - Existing network of CTO and CIO relationships at enterprise accounts in your region - Prior Field CTO or equivalent externally facing technical role at a major cloud or AI company - Fluent in multiple languages spoken across your region WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Staff Product Designer - AI Products
items.location_text: United Kingdom, Brazil, United Arab Emirates, Ireland, Peru, Sweden, Colombia, Argentina, Romania, Cyprus, Switzerland, Portugal, Lithuania, South Africa, Czech Republic, Canada, Hungary, Mexico, Chile, Poland, Spain, Bulgaria
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Forget crypto. Fintech/crypto are now one of the same. Come join us to lead Product Design for the building of elite AI products, end-to-end. A personal finance agent that shapes how people spend, save invest and live. You’ll have real ownership of the design work: the experiences you shape, and how they look, feel and behave. You’ll work directly with product, engineering and leadership, with no layers of process between you and the work. This is a rare 0→1 opportunity. The choices you make will shape the products and the people who use them. We’re a small, hardworking team that moves fast and ships with purpose. We’re straight-talking, no-nonsense, and deeply invested in the quality of what we build. We care about craft, we care about our customers, and we care about getting things right. If you’re excited by hard problems, high standards, no egos and the chance to build something genuinely new, climb aboard. THE OPPORTUNITY - Own design end to end: discovery, concept, prototyping, delivery and launch. You are the designer, with real ownership of the outcome. - Take products from zero to one, turning an early idea or a rough problem space into something real that people use. - Build new AI products for external B2C customers, and internal AI products that shape and redefine the way that Payward works. - Thrive in ambiguity. Define the problem, set the direction and make the call when nobody has handed you a brief. - Design for non-deterministic experiences, where outputs vary and the system doesn’t behave the same way twice. Shape how people interact with, understand and trust intelligent systems. - Create visually rich, forward-thinking work that sets new benchmarks for what AI products can look and feel like. - Partner directly with product, engineering and leadership, and influence strategy and roadmap decisions, not just execution. - Prototype fast to make ideas tangible, test them and learn, then move on to the next one. - Conduct user research and use customer insights, data and experimentation to decide what to build, and keep improving it after launch. - Hold a high bar for craft and user experience in everything you ship. WHAT YOU BRING - 7+ years of experience in product design, with a portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft and impact. - A track record of taking products from zero to launch as the lead or only designer, owning the full design process end to end. - World class product thinking: Real comfort with ambiguity, you find direction when requirements are unclear, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and adapt as things change. - Experience designing for non-deterministic experiences, such as AI-powered, generative or probabilistic products, is highly desirable. - Strong UX and visual design skills, with a record of solving open-ended problems with clarity and elegance. - Advanced prototyping skills, with the ability to communicate complex interactions and ideas quickly. - Experience influencing product strategy and cross-functional decision-making. - Strong systems thinking, with the ability to create coherent, scalable experiences from scratch. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Stay connected Follow us on Twitter https://twitter.com/krakenfx Learn on the Kraken Blog https://blog.kraken.com/#:~:text=Enter%20your%20email%20address Connect on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/kraken-exchange/ Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.kraken.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice

items.title: Senior Product Manager, Risk
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . Senior Product Manager, Risk As a Senior Product Manager on the Risk team within the Consumer & Business group, you'll own the product strategy and roadmap for how Coinbase detects, prevents, and responds to fraud, account takeover, and scam risk across our platform. This team builds the products and risk controls that protect millions of customers and billions in assets. You'll partner with Engineering, Data Science, and Risk Analytics to ship products that stay ahead of evolving threats while keeping the customer experience fast and frictionless. What you'll do: Own the product roadmap for one or more risk domains (e.g., ATO prevention, scam detection, payment fraud), defining the vision, priorities, and success metrics that reduce customer losses and improve detection accuracy Drive cross-functional execution with Engineering, Data Science, and Design to ship risk products from concept through launch, making trade-offs between speed, coverage, and user experience Partner with Risk Analytics and ML teams to translate fraud signals, model outputs, and emerging threat patterns into product requirements and control strategies Lead experimentation and measurement of risk interventions, using data to quantify impact on fraud rates, false positive rates, and customer friction Shape the long-term risk product strategy by analyzing industry trends, regulatory shifts, and crypto-specific threat vectors to keep Coinbase ahead of adversaries Required Skills and Experience: 7+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on risk, fraud, trust and safety, or payments in a consumer fintech or e-commerce environment Proven track record shipping risk or fraud products that measurably reduced loss rates, improved detection precision, or scaled risk controls across multiple product surfaces Deep fluency in data-driven decision-making, including defining metrics, running experiments, and interpreting ML model performance to inform product direction Experience partnering with engineering and data science teams to build and iterate on real-time risk systems, rules engines, or ML-powered detection pipelines Demonstrated ability to communicate complex risk trade-offs to senior leadership, translating technical fraud concepts into clear business impact narratives Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)). Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus): $207,485 — $244,100 USD Application Limit: Candidates may submit a maximum of 3 applications within a 6-month period. Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. US Applicants: View Employee Rights , Know Your Rights , and E-Verify Notice of Participation. Accommodations: If you are an individual with a disability who needs a reasonable accommodation, email us your request and contact info at accommodations[at]coinbase.com. Need screen reading technology? Click here to download a free compatible screen reader and view the tutorial . Data Privacy & Arbitration: By submitting your application, you agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice . US applicants: By submitting your application, you agree to Arbitration of Disputes .

IT Tier 2 Support Engineer As an ITSS In-Office Support Engineer on our IT Team, you'll be the hands-on technology partner keeping our London office running smoothly every day. This team is the front line of IT support at Coinbase, owning hardware, software, and collaboration infrastructure across our global offices. You'll troubleshoot issues in real time, manage onboarding and off-boarding workflows, and drive improvements that make every employee's experience faster and more reliable. What you'll do: Own day-to-day technical support for the London office, resolving hardware, software, networking, and AV/conference room issues across macOS, iOS, Chrome OS, Windows, and Android platforms Drive onboarding and offboarding operations end to end, ensuring every new hire is productive on Day 1 and every departure is handled securely and efficiently Maintain and improve IT documentation, including setup guides, troubleshooting runbooks, and knowledge base articles that keep pace with live systems and evolving tooling Partner with IT Procurement and local vendors to coordinate hardware logistics, supply chain processes, and office technology refresh cycles Lead first-line network and AV troubleshooting, triaging issues to specialized teams with clear diagnostics and context to accelerate resolution Execute on IT Operations scrum team projects, contributing to initiatives that scale support capabilities and reduce manual effort across the global service desk Required Skills and Experience: 2+ years in IT support, service desk, or endpoint engineering with hands-on experience supporting macOS, iOS, Chrome OS, Windows, and Android in a corporate environment Working proficiency administering SaaS platforms including Google Workspace, Atlassian (Jira Service Management), Okta, Jamf, and Slack, with the ability to troubleshoot access, provisioning, and items.title: Senior Video Creative, Performance - Kraken Consumer
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships. THE OPPORTUNITY As our Senior Performance Video Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid video for Kraken and Krak. You ideate, generate, edit and ship, and you treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot. You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and speed leadership: you set the bar for paid video on the team, work with AI-enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with video questions. - Own paid video for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity. - Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform’s specs and native feel. - Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets. - Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn’t. Keep your tooling current as the models change, and build repeatable workflows the rest of the team can reuse. - Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, including experimental ones alongside BAU work, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using. - Version and localize video at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you’ll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets. - Build creative with testing in mind. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts. - Flex into AI-assisted paid static when a campaign calls for it, working from the team’s brand baselines. - Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea. - Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on. WHAT YOU BRING - 5+ years in performance video creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category. - A portfolio submitted with your application. Paid video above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you’re able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed. - Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut. - High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it. - Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one. - Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You’re fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision. - Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic instincts and a feel for what’s about to feel dated. - Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes. - Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with work that survives risk warnings, disclaimers and market-specific requirements. - A solid copywriting instinct for scripts and on-screen text. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. items.title: Executive Assistant to VP, Cloud & VP, Product
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As an Executive Assistant at Mistral, you will support two senior leaders: our VP, Cloud and our VP, Product. These are distinct teams with their own leadership, stakeholders, and priorities. You will be the operational backbone for both, with stakeholders spanning engineering, product, go-to-market, customers, partners, and investors across France, Europe, and the US. The role has been created because both organizations are scaling fast and their leaders' time is the scarcest resource. You will own the leaders' calendars, communications, travel, and meeting preparation end to end and go further: coordinating cross-functional initiatives, running leadership rituals, and supporting high-stakes external moments such as customer and partner engagements, roadshows, and board or investor touchpoints. Balancing two executives from different teams takes real judgment: you will arbitrate scheduling conflicts, keep both leaders ahead of commitments, and handle sensitive information with discretion, representing them with professionalism in every interaction. This is a role with real ownership where you will design the processes, dashboards, and ways of working that keep two distinct organizations running smoothly. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Run the VP, Cloud's and VP, Product's calendars and priorities across multiple time zones, arbitrating between competing demands to protect their focus for strategic decisions. - Prepare briefings, agendas, presentations, and follow-up notes for leadership, board, investor, customer, and partner meetings. - Act as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders on behalf of both leaders, handling email, Slack, and calls with clarity, judgment, and confidentiality. - Coordinate international and domestic travel for both executives, including itineraries for customer roadshows and executive offsites across Europe and the US. - Organize internal and external events end to end including team gatherings, client meetings, offsites, and company-wide moments. - Drive cross-functional projects and initiatives that connect the Cloud and Product organizations with GTM, Engineering, Datacenter, and People & Operations, from planning through follow-through. - Build and maintain both orgs' operational backbone including documentation, dashboards, shared folders, and tracking of deadlines and deliverables. - Spot inefficiencies and own process improvements or special projects that raise the bar for how both organizations operate. SKILLS WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Proven experience supporting senior executives (VP level or above) as an Executive Assistant, ideally multiple leaders simultaneously, in tech, infrastructure, or other complex high-growth environments. - Exceptional communication skills in English and fluency in French is essential. - Demonstrated judgment in balancing competing priorities across multiple leaders, teams, and time zones with discretion and confidentiality. - Strong command of Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, plus productivity tools such as Notion and Slack. - A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset - you anticipate needs, close loops, and take ownership of outcomes without being asked. - A genuine interest in AI and technical products. You learn quickly and engage credibly with engineers, product managers, customers, and executives. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Head of Product Marketing
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE The Marketing team at Polymarket is responsible for telling the world what Polymarket is, why it matters, and why trading here is better than reading a poll. We work across growth, brand, comms, and product, and we move fast because the news moves fast. As Head of Product Marketing, you'll own how we bring Polymarket's product to market. You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Growth, and Comms, translating what we're building into clear positioning, compelling stories, and go-to-market strategies that drive adoption and usage. You'll help shape how we position the product, which audiences we prioritize, how we launch new features and verticals, and how we communicate the value of Polymarket to both existing and prospective traders. You'll bring customer insights and competitive intelligence back into Product, ensuring we're not just marketing what we build, but helping inform what we build. This is a high-ownership role with significant surface area. You'll touch everything from new market verticals and trading mechanics to mobile onboarding, rewards, and major company-level launches. You'll also have the opportunity to build and scale the Product Marketing function as Polymarket grows. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own the product marketing strategy and function, including positioning, messaging, audience strategy, and go-to-market planning. - Partner closely with Product and Growth leadership to shape product strategy based on customer insights, competitive intelligence, and market trends. - Develop clear positioning and messaging for Polymarket's product, features, market verticals, and key initiatives. - Own go-to-market strategy for major product launches, from defining the audience and narrative through channel strategy, execution, and post-launch analysis. - Build launch frameworks and processes that enable Product, Marketing, Growth, and Comms to move quickly and stay aligned. - Develop deep understanding of Polymarket's users, including why they trade, what drives adoption, and where we can improve conversion and retention. - Translate complex product mechanics into simple, compelling narratives that make sense to both existing traders and new audiences. - Lead competitive research and market intelligence, using those insights to inform positioning and product decisions. - Partner with Brand, Social, Communications, and Growth to ensure product messaging is consistent and differentiated across every channel. - Establish measurement frameworks for product marketing and evaluate launches based on adoption, engagement, trading activity, and revenue. - Lead post-launch analysis and turn learnings into improvements to product positioning, messaging, and future GTM strategy. - Build and manage the Product Marketing team as the function grows. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 8+ years of experience in product marketing, ideally at a high-growth consumer technology company. - Has owned product marketing strategy and major B2C go-to-market launches from positioning through execution and measurement. - Exceptional at translating complex products or concepts into simple, compelling positioning and messaging. - Strong strategic thinker who can connect customer insights, product strategy, and business objectives. - Proven ability to influence Product, Growth, Brand, and Comms teams without relying on direct authority. - Deep understanding of customer research, competitive intelligence, segmentation, positioning, and go-to-market strategy. - Excellent written and verbal communicator. Can write everything from a one-line product message to a comprehensive GTM strategy. - Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities change quickly and launches can be driven by breaking news or live events. - Highly analytical and comfortable using data to understand product adoption, customer behavior, and marketing performance. - Strong operator who can move between high-level strategy and hands-on execution. - (Plus) Genuine interest in news, sports, politics, or financial markets. - (Plus) Experience with event-driven products or marketing tied to live sports, elections, breaking news, or other real-time events. - (Plus) Experience building or managing a Product Marketing team. BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $300,000 to $375,000, plus equity and benefits. This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.

items.location_text: Remote, United States, New York, Boston, Washington, D.C.
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability. Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems. Responsibilities: Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market You may be a good fit if you have: 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems Comfortable with Python Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
